claims.summary: The release is grounded in the fresh deployed v0.15.97 UX ZIP/log audit and its projected v0.15.98 regrade, which found the exact malformed Lesson 10 discussion text.
Discussion compiler text now avoids brittle concept-as-noun-modifier slots for article-led concepts.
The regression recreates a ten-lesson UX/A-B testing course and verifies Lesson 10 exports the corrected uncertainty phrasing while blocking the old malformed variants.
The release is scoped to one known format debt item after v0.15.98 source-truth hardening and does not claim source, texture, or provider output are clean.
The release records that the next deployed audit must verify source quarantine and grammar repair in real provider output before quality improvement is claimed.
